title: Scout Mercenary

game_text: {pilot:2}, 3: speeder bikes. During battle, unless Gall on table, may use 1 Force to fire a DH-17 blaster twice (for free), separately or combined. While piloting a vehicle, she may use its defense value and may not go missing (except from your card).
